h: The Renewing Light of Shabbos and the Hidden World

p: On Shabbos, at all the meals,
we make mention of the light,
through the menorah and the lamps that we kindle
That is, through the lamps we merit
as is stated in the Gemara (Niddah 30b)
"When His lamp shone over my head":
"and a lamp is lit over its head,
from one end of the world to the other."
"The light that HaKadosh Baruch Hu created
a person could see by it
from one end of the world to the other";
and this is the meaning of "upon the heads."
And in the morning too we say,
which is also the primordial light,
through the light of the Shechinah,
as we said the meaning of
And at the third meal we say,
"to behold the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin";
and it is like what we say
"Yaakov and his sons rest on it."
akin to the holiness of the meals,
as is written (in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 18),
(as is written in Sefer Matteh Moshe);
"You are One and Your Name is One"
of Kudsha Brich Hu and His Shechinah.
"Yaakov and his sons rest on it":
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (רוּת א, ט)
in the manner of what is said (Rus 1:9):
each in the house of her husband."
And this is a complete rest,
a rest of truth and faith,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
"He is truth and She is faith."
"Just as there is in your heart only One";
that is, in the aspect of truth,
even though it does not shine for us
explicitly in the aspect of truth,
it is clear for us too,
"and there is in our heart only One."
'Blessed is the Name of His glorious kingdom
to behold the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
and it is only the members of the palace,
who are called "members of the palace,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
through the longing and the desire
"Her husband is known in the gates";
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קג, ב)
and it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 103b):
who is known and cleaved to
according to what one estimates in his heart…"

p: וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קנט, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (on this parshah, Zohar III 159b):
when it reckons the three worlds:
and it ascends and is crowned
'And it shall be from one new moon to the next.'
But the secret of the matter:
because of the renewal of the moon…" and so on,
That is, as we said earlier,
that every month has a new holiness;
which is why it is called chodesh,
for each month the moon receives
That is not so for the year,
for each year it returns and goes around,
and it is the light that was before.
And this is the meaning of "to its new moon."
"And from one Shabbos to the next":
from the words of Torah of the parshah
that is, the attribute of Malchus;
"'to its Shabbos': this is the sun,
for its light comes to it from there."
And this is because the Shabbos of the night,
and it is the Shabbos of Yisrael.
And the Shabbos of the day,
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּהַקְדָּמָה בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ ה, ב)
(as is written in the introduction of the holy Zohar, 5b),
is the Shabbos of Hashem Yisbarach.
And this is "Shabbos to its Shabbos":
is that which receives from the sun,
"For Hashem God is a sun and a shield";
וְאֵין תּוֹרָה אֶלָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
and Torah is nothing but Kudsha Brich Hu
and Yaakov is the aspect of the sun,
the sun has come…" and so on;
"who revealed to him that my name is Sun?"
And his sons, who are called the moon,
and then "Yaakov and his sons rest on it."
that it was fitting to be
just as Atzeres is after Pesach;
That is not so in the future,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רֵישׁ פְּסִיקְתָּא לְשַׁבָּת וְרֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ)
(as is written at the start of the Pesikta for Shabbos and Rosh Chodesh);
then there will be an obligation
And in this world it is optional,
"It is neither new moon nor Shabbos";
and they learned in the Gemara (Rosh Hashanah 16b)
that one is obligated to greet his teacher on the festival;
on every Shabbos and new moon,
just as they were not obligated
to come and bow down in this world,
and had it been new moon or Shabbos,
that it was fitting to go greet him.
to behold the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin
For Shabbos is akin to the World to Come;
the meal of the field of holy apples,
as they said in the Gemara (Taanis 29b)
"like the fragrance of a field which Hashem has blessed":
"the fragrance of a field of apples";
and in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah, end of parshah 65, 65:22):
the fragrance of my son is like the fragrance of a field.'"
And this is the second world
stated in the holy Zohar there,
And by day it is "to its Shabbos";
and this is what the holy Zohar says:
hidden and sealed…" and so on;
what He will do for one who waits for Him.'"
"He will do" is in the third person,
and "You will do" is not written;
and this is in the morning,
And chiefly at the third meal

p: only about the days of Mashiach;
but as for the World to Come,
was the World to Come created with a yud?
Because the tzaddikim in it are few."
And in the Mishnah it says (Sanhedrin 90a):
So how will they be few?
Will it not be all Yisrael,
But one is called a tzaddik
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קנח, א)
And in the holy Zohar (on this parshah, Zohar III 158a):
does not dwell with Kudsha Brich Hu,
and he will have no share
'For… evil shall not dwell with You.'"
That is, it is about one who blemishes his covenant,
But it is stated in the Gemara (Kiddushin 49b):
"On condition that I am a tzaddik
for perhaps he thought of teshuvah in his mind."
And although the definition of teshuvah is
that the Knower of hidden things will testify about him
that he will not return again
that he still conducts himself in his wickedness
but whenever, at the time he thought of teshuvah,
שֶׁאָז הָיָה בְּגֶדֶר בַּעַל תְּשׁוּבָה הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
so that he was then within the definition of a baal teshuvah mentioned above,
and he returned to his corrupt ways,
nevertheless at the time of the act,
he was within the definition of a tzaddik as his condition stated;
And this is "And your people are all tzaddikim":
for there is no one of Yisrael
who will not have a thought of teshuvah,
and they will be included in
"The Garden is one sixtieth of Eden,
and Eden is one sixtieth of Gehinnom."
And it is stated in Sefer Asarah Maamaros
by Rabbi Menachem Azaryah of Fano
that in the future Gehinnom will be sanctified
with the holiness of Gan Eden.
like the spring of the shissin;
'the guide too will be wrapped in blessings':
that they justify…" and so on.
they extinguish the fire of Gehinnom,
and their praise rises from Gehinnom,
And this is sixty times as much as Eden,
who never blemished at all in their lives,
And this is what is stated,
"that the tzaddikim in it are few";
over which there has not ruled
And this is what it says:
"As for the World to Come, no eye has seen";
And it is possible that what is written in the Gemara,
where baalei teshuvah stand…" and so on
are the words of the living God.
which is one sixtieth of Eden,
is so also in the measure of
the superiority of the holiness of Eden
over the holiness of the Garden,
which is a sixtieth of Gehinnom:
when it is sanctified with the holiness of Gan Eden,
will also be superior to Eden,
and in some respect it is superior;
for it is "no eye has seen,"
and the prophets did not grasp
And this is why the Gemara says "and this disputes";
of our Sages, of blessed memory:
"both these and those are the words of the living God."
And this is what the holy Zohar says:
which no one knows…" and so on.
And Shabbos is a time of teshuvah,
"It is good to give thanks to Hashem";
"He who confesses and forsakes will be shown mercy."
and they will be able to merit
to behold the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּאִדְּרָא נָשׂא, חֵלֶק ג קלו, ב)
as is written (in the Idra, Nasso, Zohar III 136b):
"The face of the Ancient of Days shines
upon the face of the Short of Days,
and His forehead is revealed…" and so on,
"and then it is called a time of favor."
